::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 12th 1890  
**From:** Elderfield Otterboune  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell.
:::

My dear [Lady Meath](people/person_985.qmd)

[Annie Cazenove](people/person_274.qmd) and I agree that you would be greatly interested in Miss [Margaretta Scott](people/person_2435.qmd)'s work.  She is an American Churchwoman hard at work among the girls of superior class in Liberia

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

Annie Cazenove is as bright and energetic as ever
